 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjeev Narula
 Order

The present petition seeks quashing of FIR No. 111/2021 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 18601 registered at P.S. Krishna Nagar premised on a compromise between the Petitioners and Respondent No. 2.
2.

Noticing non-appearance on behalf of the parties, the Court had issued notice to Respondent No.
2 through the concerned Investigating Officer on 3rd September, 2025.
3. S.I. Shivam Sahu, P.S. Krishna Nagar, submits that Respondent No. 2 has been duly informed of the present proceedings, but has conveyed her unwillingness to appear.
The counsel representing Respondent No. 2 has communicated a similar position.

"IPC"
